title: On smooth elements in arithmetic semigroups
summary: In this paper we explore the concept of smoothness in arithmetic semigroups. In particular, we give explicit asymptotics for the counting function $Ψ_G(x,y)$ when the arithmetic semigroup $G$ satisfies Axiom A (in the spirit of Knopfmacher). The asymptotics generalise the standard results in the literature for the integer case, and are expressed in terms of the Dickman $ρ$ function. Finally, we give applications of our results to counting smooth families of finite abelian groups and finite semisimple rings.
